mods.why: General purpose library most serious mods build on. Covers RPC, networked variables, mod storage, a module system, logging, an event handler, localisation, file and stream helpers, cryptography, type converters and an expression VM.
Admin tools with a permissions and roles framework, and a modular design other mods plug their own admin menus into. Built on CF, so depending on COT pulls CF in as well.
The other widely used library. The bundled mod template already lists it in Workbench project.cfg as Mods=@Dabs Framework.
